issues.train_py_gyro_merge: np.searchsorted over unsorted gyro timestamps -> 82%/83% zero-gyro windows; also 20 Hz assumed for every block
issues.hart_model_test_fixture: fixture manifest pins the pretrained checkpoint digest
issues.harness_streams_arm: streams drops imu-feat-1 windows while inertia keeps them; A0 = hart arm on an encoder-free file
issues.nav_stairs_fold: naive-average fold maps stairs->walking; HART C10 maps stairs->other_movement
issues.random_init_standin_load: runtime._resolve_encoder passes P2's encoder card (encoder.json) to the registry as an Inertia encoder config -> config_mismatch; serve would report inertia_unavailable for shadow-primary-art; replay injects the registry-built encoder (same config sha256, consistency check enforced)
issues.xctest_env_dump: XCTest can print the whole process environment (contained an API key); replay runner filters output
